name: ListAutomateResponseConfigs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automated response rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who created the rule
parameters.name: sub_user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the playbook
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en: The name of the automated response rule
parameters.help_zh: 自动化响应配置规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the automated response. Valid values:

event

alert
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应类型。取值：
event：事件
alert：告警
parameters.name: auto_response_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the handling action. Valid values:

doPlaybook: executes a playbook.

changeEventStatus: changes the status of an event.

changeThreatLevel: changes the threat level of an event
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作类型。取值：
doPlaybook：执行剧本
changeEventStatus：更改事件状态
changeThreatLevel：更改事件威胁等级
parameters.name: action_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

0: disabled

100: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。取值：
0：未启用
100：启用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be 1 or greater
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号，大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the response rule.

preset: predefined

custom: custom
parameters.help_zh:
响应规则类型。

preset：预定义
custom：自定义
parameters.name: response_rule_type
